# CLAUDE.md — Quick Start & CLI Reference

This document provides quick reference commands, project layout details, and development workflows for Claude and AGY CLI.

---

## 1. Quick Commands

### Backend Commands (Django REST Framework)
- **Start Backend API**: `python backend/manage.py runserver 8000`
- **Run Migrations**: `python backend/manage.py migrate`
- **Make Migrations**: `python backend/manage.py makemigrations`
- **Seed Sample Tasks**: `python backend/manage.py seed_tasks`
- **Django Shell**: `python backend/manage.py shell`

### Frontend Commands (React + Vite + pnpm)
- **Start Client Dev Server**: `cd client && pnpm dev`
- **Build Client for Production**: `cd client && pnpm build`
- **Preview Production Build**: `cd client && pnpm preview`

---

## 2. API Reference

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api`

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/tasks/` | GET | List all tasks sorted by `created_at` descending |
| `/api/tasks/` | POST | Create new task (title, description, status, priority, assignee) |
| `/api/tasks/{id}/` | GET | Retrieve single task |
| `/api/tasks/{id}/` | PATCH / PUT | Update task fields (e.g. status or priority) |
| `/api/tasks/{id}/` | DELETE | Delete task |

---

## 3. Project Structure

